Class FieldReplicationService.Settings

public class FieldReplicationService.Settings

Wrapper class that encapsulates field replication configuration from ReplicationSettings__mdt metadata. Contains all settings needed to define parent-child relationships, field mappings, and validation rules for the replication process.
